description: Use this when the user needs to upload an attached audio file, upload a local audio file in stdio mode, or import from a link: a public HTTPS link to an audio file, or a music page on SoundCloud, YouTube, Suno, Udio, TikTok, Stable Audio, or Riffusion. Provide exactly one of file, file_path, or url. Returns music_id for generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, generate_lyric_video and other audio workflows. Does not generate audio or video.

file_path.description: Local audio file path for stdio installations. Not available on the hosted server.

url.description: Public HTTPS link to an audio file, or a music page on SoundCloud, YouTube, Suno, Udio, TikTok, Stable Audio, or Riffusion. Set this or file_path, not both.

name: upload_audio

outputSchema.description: On success, returns the tool result fields. On error, returns success:false, error and code, with optional credit approval details; success-only fields are absent.

message.description: A human-readable summary of the audio source preparation result.

music_id.description: The audio asset ID to pass into generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, generate_lyric_video, or generate_effect.

anyOf.description: Whether the audio upload or import completed successfully.
